        print(json.dumps(ud, indent=2, default=str))

# Get flights from LAX to SFO available on 2026-09-10

print(f"Found {len(flight_rows)} flights")
for fr in flight_rows:
    fd = dict(fr)
    dates_data = json.loads(fd['dates_json'])
    date_info = dates_data.get('2026-09-10', {})

    print(f"  Prices: {date_info.get('prices', 'N/A')}")
    print(f"  Source: {fd['source_skill']}")
    print()

conn.close()
'''
